en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small European town dominated by low, pitched‑roof houses and a central open square or market area. The buildings are mostly 2–3 stories, with a few larger rectangular institutional blocks in the background and dense tree cover around the residential streets. Farmland and forest lie beyond the town edge. No visible caption or border elements appear within the image itself.
